# Distributor Bulletin DB-2031-07: TX-40 Service Guidance

**Issuer:** Harrowgate Instrument Supply (authorised distributor)
**Issued:** 2031-01-20
**Authority:** distributor guidance, not a manufacturer specification

## 1. Service interval

Harrowgate recommends a calibration interval of 120 days for TX-40 probes in
temperate deployments. Field data collected by our service technicians in 2030
did not show measurable degradation before day 118.

## 2. Accuracy in the field

In our own bench comparisons the TX-40 held ±1.2% volumetric water content
across the full operating band, which is tighter than the manufacturer's
published figure.

## 3. Elevation

Harrowgate has observed no adverse behaviour up to 3,000 m and does not
consider an elevation variance necessary below that altitude.

## 4. Ordering

Replacement frits may be ordered through the distributor portal at
https://portal.example.org/torvane or by writing to
service-desk@example.com.

## 5. Automated processing note
